title: Intriguing Properties of Compression on Multilingual Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the disparate impact of model compression (Iterative Magnitude Pruning) on Named Entity Recognition (NER) performance across 40 languages, grouping the languages by resource availability (fine-tuning data size), language family, and script. The methodology also includes testing model robustness through entity mention replacement perturbations across these language groups.
